title: Compute and display the combined license of a score's music, with the reason
description:
Today creditsOf() (web/src/data/licenses.ts) lists credits and reports the first share-alike license it meets. Nothing computes the license the finished music must carry, and 3.0 vs 4.0 share-alike is not reconciled.

Add a pure combinedLicense() and show it in the credits panel (web/src/ui/credits.ts) as a computed license: say it is computed from the licenses of the sounds the score uses, state what it is, and say why (which sounds drive it). Rules: any share-alike sound => the highest share-alike version among them (CC BY-SA 3.0 permits adapting under a later version with the same elements); else any CC BY => credit required, no other condition; else all public domain/CC0/LoC-free/US-gov => no conditions, credit is a courtesy; any undocumented sound => not determined, name them. Not legal advice; covers sample licenses only. Tests first in web/test/licenses.test.ts. Web-session files with uncommitted edits (library.ts, score.ts, docs.ts, main.ts, route.ts, style.css) are not touched.
